result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major unlocalized section title and a minor layout overflow on a restaurant name.

issues.description: The popular restaurants section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') so the heading matches the rest of the UI.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is clipped at the right edge of its card in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines or truncate with an ellipsis so the full (or clearly abbreviated) name stays within the card.
